summary: EFCAR, LLC, as depositor for Exeter Select Automobile Receivables Trust 2026-2, filed an 8-K detailing an auto-loan ABS issuance. On September 22, 2026, EFCAR and sponsor Exeter Finance LLC signed an underwriting agreement with Mizuho, Citigroup and Wells Fargo as representatives. The trust will issue eight note classes totaling roughly $504.1M, closing September 28, 2026, backed by sub-prime auto receivables under an August 31, 2026 purchase agreement. This is a routine securitization takedown, not a special situation; watch spread pricing, credit enhancement and servicer performance.
